note: Claim-level dataset changelog. One entry per dataset revision, hand-refreshed on every bump by diffing the previous published dataset (git show <prev>:src/data/policy/policy-claims-2026-Q3.json) against the new one, mirroring SINCE_LAST_REVIEW in src/lib/policy/config.ts. Claim statements are verbatim from the dataset; sources are resolved at render time from the registry by sourceIds, never duplicated here. The page must never run git at request time.

entries.summary: Kenya licensing pillar expanded from 1 to 4 claims: the r13 investigation (CDH TMT licensing alert + two trade reports, all captured free via manual curl, zero API credits) registered the NFP-Tier 2 baseline, the CA's 8 September 2026 standalone-licence proposal and the proposed fee schedule. No existing claims, sources or gap records were modified.

claims.previousVersionNote: Not present in r12 - the Kenya licensing pillar held only KE-LC-C1.
claims.statement: Kenya's Unified Licensing Framework contains no data-centre-specific licence category: co-location data centres are licensed under the Network Facilities Provider - Tier 2 category of the Revised Telecommunications Market Structure (gazetted 6 March 2026).
claims.editorialDecision: Registered r13 (2026-09-24) under the editor's standing humanGate delegation, conditional on verification. Verified on two independent corroborating sources: CDH law-firm alert (T2) plus Techafricanews and w.media (T3). Single-source detail (NFP-Tier 1 reliance, per CDH) is held inside the claim note, not upgraded.

claims.previousVersionNote: Not present in r12 - the Kenya licensing pillar held only KE-LC-C1.
claims.statement: On 8 September 2026 the Communications Authority of Kenya published a public notice opening a 30-day comment window on a proposal to introduce a standalone data centre licence category for co-location data centre operators, replacing the Network Facilities Provider - Tier 2 treatment.
claims.editorialDecision: Registered r13 (2026-09-24) under the same delegation. Verified on T2 + two independent T3 corroborations; CA notice rationale and coverage quoted verbatim via w.media. Proposal-stage claim: flagged as likely to change or lapse during consultation. Upgrade path: capture the CA public notice itself (ca.go.ke open-consultations JS-blocked 2026-09-24).

claims.previousVersionNote: Not present in r12 - the Kenya licensing pillar held only KE-LC-C1.
claims.statement: The CA's proposed standalone data centre licence carries a proposed fee schedule: KSh 5,000 application fee, KSh 100,000 initial fee, and an annual operating fee of KSh 80,000 or 0.4 percent of gross annual turnover, whichever is higher.
claims.editorialDecision: Registered r13 (2026-09-24) under the same delegation, held at partially-verified: single source (w.media T3 quoting the CA notice). Proposal-stage figures may change during consultation. Upgrade path: capture the CA notice or gazette instrument.

entries.editorialDecisionSummary: All four country pipelines approved for publication; r13 claims registered 2026-09-24 under the editor's standing delegation (r11/r12 precedent), conditional on verification.
